collection.title: Citroen C4 Space Tourer 2016 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen Space Tourer 2016 - 2018 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
